found: Red stretcher bond brick on the recipe's own courses, brick to brick colour varied, mortar recessed and dark. Darker mixed reds with soot spotting and fine rain streaks. No lettering, numeral, logo, badge, signature, watermark or maker's mark anywhere in the four crops, and nothing that reads as a particular real building.
statement: Every texel of every map is inside exactly one of these crops, each written at 1:1 with no resampling, and each was looked at before this set was offered for publication.
